Sandbox_GoresSVU4Core_MaterialCostMultip: Multiplies armor crafting and repair costs.
Sandbox_GoresSVU4Core_XPRewardMultiplier: Multiplies MetalWelding and Mechanics XP rewards.
Sandbox_GoresSVU4Core_SoundRadiusMultipl: Multiplies how far welding noise travels.
Sandbox_GoresSVU4Core_ArmorWeightMultipl: Multiplies added armor mass on vehicles.
Sandbox_GoresSVU4Core_GasLeakRateMultipl: Multiplies the fuel loss rate from punctured gas tank armor. Set to 0 to disable fuel leaking.
Sandbox_GoresSVU4Core_EnableSkillRequire: Enables MetalWelding and Mechanics requirements for armor grades.
Sandbox_GoresSVU4Core_EnableArmorWeight_: Enables added vehicle weight from installed armor.
Sandbox_GoresSVU4Core_EnableAdminLogs_to: Logs armor installs, repairs, removals, rejected actions, and gas leak events to the server log.
Sandbox_GoresSVU4Core_GasTankPunctureDam: Condition damage applied to the vanilla Gas Tank when gas tank armor is destroyed.
Sandbox_GoresSVU4Core_GasTankLeakClearCo: Gas Tank condition required to clear the leak after repairing the vanilla tank.
Sandbox_GoresSVU4Core_ScrapProtectionPer: Percentage of incoming damage absorbed by Scrap armor. Higher values protect the vehicle more.
Sandbox_GoresSVU4Core_StandardProtection: Percentage of incoming damage absorbed by Standard armor. Higher values protect the vehicle more.
Sandbox_GoresSVU4Core_ReinforcedProtecti: Percentage of incoming damage absorbed by Reinforced armor. Higher values protect the vehicle more.
Sandbox_GoresSVU4Core_ApocalypseProtecti: Percentage of incoming damage absorbed by Apocalypse armor. Higher values protect the vehicle more.
Sandbox_GoresSVU4Core_EnableRandomSurviv: Allows old world vehicles to spawn with random worn armor panels already installed. Server-authoritative in multiplayer.
Sandbox_GoresSVU4Core_RandomArmorScrapCh: Chance each vehicle/panel roll can spawn worn Scrap armor. Scrap should usually be the most common.
Sandbox_GoresSVU4Core_RandomArmorStandar: Chance each vehicle/panel roll can spawn worn Standard armor.
Sandbox_GoresSVU4Core_RandomArmorReinfor: Chance each vehicle/panel roll can spawn worn Reinforced armor.
Sandbox_GoresSVU4Core_RandomArmorApocaly: Chance each vehicle/panel roll can spawn worn Apocalypse armor. Keep this low for rare survivor builds.
Sandbox_GoresSVU4Core_RandomArmorMinHeal: Minimum health for randomly spawned survivor armor panels.
Sandbox_GoresSVU4Core_RandomArmorMaxHeal: Maximum health for randomly spawned survivor armor panels.
Sandbox_GoresSVU4Core_RandomArmorMaxPane: Maximum Random Armor Panels Per Vehicle
Maximum number of worn armor panels a vehicle can receive from random survivor armor spawning.
Sandbox_GoresSVU4Core_MultiInstallMode_t: Controls how players can queue armor installs. Single only disables batch installing. One grade allows batch installs but clears the selection when changing grade. Full multi-install allows mixed grades in one batch.
Sandbox_GoresSVU4Core_MaxQueuedActions_t: Limits how many armor actions a player can queue from one batch button press. This applies to batch install, batch repair, and batch remove. Single actions are unaffected.
Sandbox_GoresSVU4Core_EnableScrapArmorGr: Allows players to install Scrap armor. Existing Scrap armor can still be removed or repaired unless another compatibility rule blocks it.
Sandbox_GoresSVU4Core_EnableStandardArmo: Allows players to install Standard armor. Existing Standard armor can still be removed or repaired unless another compatibility rule blocks it.
Sandbox_GoresSVU4Core_EnableReinforcedAr: Allows players to install Reinforced armor. Existing Reinforced armor can still be removed or repaired unless another compatibility rule blocks it.
Sandbox_GoresSVU4Core_EnableApocalypseAr: Allows players to install Apocalypse armor. Existing Apocalypse armor can still be removed or repaired unless another compatibility rule blocks it.
Sandbox_GoresSVU4Core_BlockAllSVU4ArmorO: Block SVU4 Armor on KI5 Vehicles
When enabled, Gore's SVU4 will not install armor on any detected KI5 / that DAMN Library vehicle. Use the vehicle's native armor system instead.
